candidates.text: The overture’s soft final chords were a setup: they lead straight into G minor, the key of Ilia’s scene.
candidates.scene: Act I: Quando avran fine omai

evidence: These chords, soft and tentative, turn out not to be a resolution of the overture in the tonic but chords in the dominant of G minor, which is the home key of the scene that immediately follows.
